why: The vocabulary check dropped, so `--enemyRole barrel` -- this flag's own earlier value name, and exactly what a stale capture command would say -- is forwarded to the page, fails `isEnemyRoleCue` there, resolves to null, and shoots the SHIPPED tank while reporting success. For a flag whose entire job is comparing prototypes against each other, a silent fallback to the baseline is the worst possible failure: the sheet looks complete and one cell is quietly the control.
killedBy: gallery args pins --enemyRole to the vocabulary the renderer actually owns
